resources.string: This script uses ES6 template strings (backticks), which the Rhino engine cannot compile. Switched to the QuickJS engine; add "// @engine quickjs" as the first line to make it stick.
ES6 template strings in this script were rewritten as string concatenation, so it keeps running on the Rhino engine (widgets such as canvas are only available there).
This script uses the ui.layout(<xml>) XML-literal form, which the QuickJS engine cannot parse. Switched to the Rhino engine; add "// @engine rhino" as the first line to make it stick.
